description: An unofficial, drop-in Trakt plugin fork with per-user self-service and optional, administrator-controlled integration for other applications.
name: Better Trakt
overview: Trakt sync with user self-service and Foreseer integration

versions.changelog:
Targets **Jellyfin 12.1** (.NET 10) and merges official Trakt v33. Built against the Jellyfin 12.1.0 packages; verified to load on Jellyfin 12.1, 12.2 and 12.3. Stay on `1000.2026.909.1` for Jellyfin 12.0.

### Upstream v33
- Paginated collection and playback imports, bounded retries, resilient metadata handling and fewer Trakt requests (jellyfin/jellyfin-plugin-trakt#311). Thanks @StefanFriptu and @crobibero.

### Fixes from upstream PRs not yet merged there
Thanks to @zotabee for these fixes and for permission to include them, and to @ttybitnik.

**Watch history**
- Never unmark episodes watched on Trakt when the watched import is skipped (#326).
- Only remove Trakt history when an item is actually marked unwatched (#327).
- Clearer watched/unwatched import labels in the admin and self-service pages (#332).

**Account linking**
- Keep the access token when a token refresh fails (#331).
- Store new tokens on the current user configuration, so an admin settings save can't lose them (#330).
- Reuse a token another task already refreshed. Better Trakt's per-user refresh locks are kept (#334).
- Revoke the stored token directly when de-authorizing (#343).

**Sync reliability**
- Keep exporting the other users when one user fails (#336), and stop the import cleanly when cancelled (#339).
- Tolerate unknown collection metadata values (#337) and fix the misspelled laserdisc media type (#324).
- Don't send pause updates that Trakt rejects (#333).
- Read show-shaped `not_found` episodes, skip pointless retries without IDs, and log the retry's not-found episodes (#335, #340).
- Match excluded library folders as whole paths (#329). Excluding a root folder such as `/` still works.
- Remove a deleted series from the Trakt collection (#338), and send new library items once, with their refreshed metadata (#341).
- Quietly skip playback events without a library item (#318, @ttybitnik).
- Opt-in extra logging is now visible at the default log level (#328).

**Collection metadata**
- Detect Dolby Atmos, DTS:X, DTS-HD and HDR10+, and follow Jellyfin's Dolby Vision detection (#320, #321).
- Describe the main audio track instead of the first one, for example skipping commentary tracks (#323).
- Fall back to the channel count for unknown audio layouts (#322).
- Use the video height too when picking the resolution (#342).

Tested on Jellyfin 12.1 against a Trakt test account: library export, collection metadata, watched-state import and export, series removal, new-item sync and token refresh.

Bug reports: https://github.com/selmant/better-trakt/issues
Targets Jellyfin 12.0 (.NET 10) and merges official Trakt v31: paginated watched sync, episode history matching, URL and null-check fixes.
Serializes per-user Trakt refreshes to protect rotating refresh tokens.
Adds the public Trakt client ID to the administrator-controlled Foreseer token bridge. No Trakt client secret or refresh token is exposed.

First Better Trakt release.

- Drop-in replacement for the official Jellyfin Trakt plugin.
- Preserves the existing plugin GUID, Trakt.dll assembly, /Trakt routes, and Trakt.xml configuration.
- Adds per-user Trakt authorization and preference self-service.
- Adds optional administrator-controlled access-token export for Foreseer and other integrations.
- Includes current upstream Jellyfin Trakt fixes for Jellyfin 10.11.

Do not run Better Trakt and the official Trakt plugin together.
